registration.rule: rose-edge-wmshell.patch enters apply-os-changes.py only after this contract compiles on a real tree (agreed on #410); this contract never registers it

proves: the Shell patch's controller, policy, mic-slot window and AIDL, the tray overlays it calls, and WMShellModule's bindings type-check and compile on the real classpath (WindowManager-Shell), and SystemUI's dagger graph accepts them (SystemUI-core). Not R8, APK packaging, signing or runtime.
provenance: every hash here is an expected value derived from pinned public sources and the committed patches; an adapter compares current bytes with them and never records current bytes as provenance
candidatePatches: frameworks/base in apply-os-changes.py --background-policy order, then rose-edge-wmshell.patch (candidateDelta), which apply-os-changes.py does not register; build/release as the background policy applies it. A tree integrated by any patcher today is not at these final images

branches.verifyIntegrated: every affected file equals post (config.xml only through integrationRewrite with its bound inputs), every required overlay is present with its sha256 (notAnInput overlays may be present with any bytes), every unlisted path matches its treePin, no extra path, no patch is applied again
branches.reconstruct: every affected file equals pre (sha256 and gitBlob at revision), new files and every overlay target are absent beforehand, patches are applied in order and must give exactly post; required overlays are then copied

verifyBaseApplyCandidate.status: proposal, stated as data only: Release implements it, and any run needs separate authority

conditions.text: the integrating bundle matches base.bundleContent; every affected file of every project equals base.projects post (config.xml only through integrationRewrite with its bound inputs); every required base overlay is present with its sha256 (notAnInput overlays may be present with any bytes); every unlisted path matches the project treePin; no extra path
every candidateDelta file and overlay is at its before image, or absent where before is null; anything at after, or neither, refuses

in an isolated copy only, each candidateDelta patch (sha256-checked bytes at bundlePath) passes candidateDelta.application, and each candidateDelta overlay is copied from its sha256-checked bundlePath
the copy then equals projects and overlays exactly, with the same treePin and config.xml rules; only then does the compile proceed

verifyBaseApplyCandidate.otherwise: refuse at the first failed condition, naming its id; partial, already applied or unknown state refuses

branches.otherwise: refuse: mixed pre/post, unknown hash, missing file, overlay, input or binding. A tree integrated by the current patcher (no rose-edge-wmshell.patch) is such a state at the candidate's files and must not be completed by applying rose-edge-wmshell.patch alone outside verifyBaseApplyCandidate. Never reset or trust a snapshot.

integrationRewrite.by: scripts/apply-os-changes.py, the `if policy:` block, after patching

generatingInputs.policyReceipt: agent, targets, prototypeControl; its sha256 must equal the one bound for that tree outside this contract

inputRules.rows: every agent and target row has a packageName and at least one certificate

arrays.config_pixelComputerControlTargets: Targets: every target row, in receipt order
arrays.config_pixelComputerControlPrototypeAgen: PrototypeAgents: the agent row, only when prototypeControl is true; otherwise the marker

templates.config_pixelComputerControlReferenceDisp: <string name="config_pixelComputerControlReferenceDisplayAddress" translatable="false">{address}</string> when given; otherwise the marker

compare: each element name opens exactly once in the file
each element is exactly its expected text (template from the bound inputs, or its marker)
replacing exactly those texts with their markers gives post (sha256); nothing else is normalised
a missing input or binding, a value outside inputRules, or any other difference refuses

treePin.source: revision is the pinned commit; rootTree is that commit's tree, recomputed offline from the listing (every tree object rebuilt and hashed); neither is a host fact

listing.format: <mode> SP <type> SP <oid> TAB <path> LF, as git ls-tree -r --full-tree <revision> prints it, gzip-compressed with mtime 0

unlisted.excludedAre: exactly this project's files paths and overlay targets, relative to it; no globs. A path the pinned tree lacks (a new file or an overlay target) must be absent from it and excludes nothing
unlisted.recordFormat: <mode> SP <oid> TAB <path> LF, with path relative to the project

treePin.gitlinks: none: generation refuses any mode 160000 entry

blobHash.regularFile: git hash-object -t blob --no-filters --stdin, given the file's bytes
blobHash.symlink: git hash-object -t blob --no-filters --stdin, given readlink's bytes (no trailing newline); mode 120000
blobHash.implementation: git's own collision-detecting SHA-1, through that invocation; the offline generator's blob and tree ids are confirmed against git hash-object by os/tests/test_launcher3_compile_contract.py

treePin.limitation: per-path sha256 would need every file's contents, which the bounded pinned fixtures do not hold; the pin is mode and git blob id per path from the pinned commit's own tree objects, with this sha256 digest over them
